title: low-key life changing
date: Reviewed in the United States on September 7, 2025
review: This arrived 72 hours ago, and since then we've killed at least 15 mosquitoes in the house. There are several things to like abut this model: the hanging loop, universal USB charging (it comes with a cable but not a wall adapter), the folding handle, and the satisfying ZAP. It was worked well for swatting bugs mid-flight and particularly well for trapping them against the wall while they're resting. It's been useless as a stationary bug zapper sitting on a table in constant ON mode: the purple light doesn't seem to attract mosquitoes, even when the room is dark, and the insect would have to purposely fly through the outer cage to get zapped. We've yet to kill a bug that way, and it quickly wastes battery. While standing by in manual mode, the battery life is adequate. Note that manual mode doesn't work exactly as described in the included instruction sheet. The tiny red light turns on when the button is held, but the purple backlight does not. At first I thought it was broken, but it works just fine that was and I'm more than satisfied. I think it's a mis-print in the manual.Can't believe I've survived 29 year in Florida without one of these handy things.

title: No flying insect is safe.
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 17, 2025
review: This product solves the issue of standard swatters which is needing to strike quick with precise aim. This one, the surface are is so large, you simply have wave the wand in the general direction of the insect and it will practically fly right into the zapper on its own. Plus you never need to whack anything with force to ensure its demise.This bug zapper charges quickly within a few hours and can be used a very long time before needing to recharge again. It can be used in always on mode for a continuous bug zapping spree, or on-demand mode to zap only when the button is pressed down. It also can be propped up to stand on it's own for passive bug blasting.So far, I have am 4 for 4 in mosquito take-downs and I must say it's very satisfying. The zapping noise is very loud, so if that's not your thing, then maybe it might not be for you. My only issue is I want one for every room. It's quite large... about the size of a squash racket, so carrying it on your person around the house is a bit arduous.

title: Very Impressive!
date: Reviewed in the United States on October 3, 2024
review: I have had numerous electric swatters that were just so-so and would not have considered ordering another until we had an invasion of VERY TINY house flies - not gnats, actual house flies.  I had never encountered them before but Google verified that, yes, they are a thing.  According to Google, they usually do not land on food but the minute I set foot in the kitchen to start prepping a meal, one would start attacking and they were crawling all over the kitchen counters which was disgusting.  Direct hits with Flying Insect Spray did not faze them (unlike regular houseflies) and using that in the kitchen is not a good thing anyway, so, after several days of dealing with them, off to Amazon I go and spot this product that got excellent reviews. In desperation,  I think I would have ordered any electric zapper but I am SO happy with this.  Had to charge them overnight, but the next morning my husband got the first ZAPP!!!!  Total annihilation, not a corpse in sight.  Later that day, I got the second one, albeit, not by zapping but by using the edge of the zapper to smash one that was trying to get away by crawling into a small gap between the counter and a window (whatever works!).  Given the level of annoyance they were creating, I assumed that we had many, but haven't seen any others since.  We typically do not have a mosquito problem so I do not know if we will utilize the stand, but I'm very happy to have 2 great zappers!  Highly recommend!

title: A fly dies and a villain is born
date: Reviewed in the United States on November 27, 2024
review: I have waged a war against the flies/gnats in our office for months (liquid baits, sticky strips, etc). This was my “Little Boy/Fat Man” moment. I’ve killed generations and ended civilizations of flies with this zapper. Some sizzle out with a quick “pop” and others arc in dramatic fashion as they bizz their last buzz. Colleagues use it when they need, but I do it for fun at this point. I hope to see another fly- I wait in excitement for the moment. It’s a game for me now.My villain arc aside, this is a grounded zapper (so you won’t zap yourself touching it when it’s on unless you touch the inner mesh). The light is bright enough to see when it’s on. It kills bugs dead (which is great because that’s why I bought it). It’s a great price, easy to store, and built to last with great battery life. It works great, and I highly recommend it (but you will probably also go to Fly Hell if you do).

title: Great Device
date: Reviewed in the United States on September 20, 2025
review: I love the foldable compact design which does not take up much storage space.  The light feature is very useful when you want to attrack fly or mosquito in the dark.  The device is powerful, almost instant kill once fly touches the wires.  Taking one star off as I wish there is a safety switch to avoid accidentally turning the device on.

title: This misquito zapper works !
date: Reviewed in the United States on September 21, 2025
review: I was wary  of buying this zap racket, but i am so glad i did ! I have tried everything i know to detour these pesky misquitos ! I have a coleman pine cented citronella candle , works pretty great compared to the other citronella candle but .... a few always persist , i just smack em with the zap racket and watch it light up ! So I'm  getting exercise , lol , having fun zapping them and you can shut it off and on easily , fold it up for storage ! I am happy with this bug zapper ! It got left out in a rain storm and still works great ! Who knew ? Great product !

title: Complete game changer!
date: Reviewed in the United States on August 31, 2025
review: I absolutely love this fly zapper! It is a complete game changer. I have killed everything from moths, mosquitos, gnats, flys, wasps, and flying ants! It is THE BEST! I've even inspired guests at our home to purchase one for their home. It' stays charged for quite awhile too. It is lightweight and easy to handle. I love that it comes with a strap so it can be hung on a hook. I highly recommend!

title: AWESOME
date: Reviewed in the United States on August 9, 2025
review: GUYS I LOVE THIS THING!I bought this for work since the door is constantly opening and letting bugs in. I went in our garage to test this out and OH MY GOSH this thing works so good! The noise level isn't bad especially when once you hear it who cares you no longer have a bug in your space lol. I keep this plugged in at the standing mode so the battery life is pretty good for me. I tested this for outside use and I'd trust this at night sitting around a table to protect me from mosquitoes and such. Works very good and no issues so far. I bought two more after my first one came and was tested!
